change: Gemma weighted RMS normalization and residual addition in one dispatch
candidate: Baseline plus reviewed RMS mode2 and runtime graph patch, including removal of both branchNorm buffers. No experimental paired-projection fusion.

hardware.note: The CDP wrapper records runner.headless=false; the dedicated Chrome process was launched with --headless=new. Hardware WebGPU and precise timestamps enabled.

metric: Geometric mean of three per-request-size median summed GPU kernel times; two warmups and five measured requests per size. Profiled GPU time, not unprofiled round-trip latency. Other families are regression checks for this Gemma-only change.
